title: Your whole game at a glance
description: A plains village in Minecraft with the Cassonade HUD: compass minimap, clock, current quest and a waypoint in the world

title: A living world
description: A flock of geese flying in a V across a clear blue sky, seen from the ground

title: World map and markers
description: Full-screen world map of the explored land around a village, with rivers, a fog of war and Tower, Farm and Mine markers

title: Backpack
description: Minecraft inventory with the Cassonade backpack open beside it, a leather panel full of items, next to the extra equipment slots

title: Compass minimap
description: Compass minimap in the top-right corner of the screen, with the biome, the coordinates and a Farm waypoint shown in the village

title: The Milky Way at night
description: The Milky Way, a faint band high in the night sky, above an open plain with flowers in the grass

title: Quest journal
description: Quest journal open on the First Steps chapter, with every chapter and its progress

title: Clock and weather forecast
description: Minecraft at dusk with the clock panel in the top-left corner: 18:36, day 1, the weather and the next weather change

title: An inventory that keeps up
description: Chest window with sort buttons, and a Shulker box tooltip showing its contents and fill bar

title: Combat awareness
description: A creeper and a spider with health bars and golden “!” marks over their heads, and the eye in the top-left corner

title: Naturalist's spyglass
description: A horse seen through the naturalist's spyglass, in a round lens, its speed, jump, health and readiness to breed in a panel under the crosshair

title: Waystone
description: A waystone in a meadow: a stone monument two blocks high with purple veins, a pink cube floating and turning above it, written in strange letters

title: Elytra slot
description: A player seen from behind wearing an iron helmet, a diamond chestplate and elytra at the same time, above a village

title: Right-click harvest
description: A field of ripe wheat on both sides of a water channel, ready for right-click harvest

title: Filtered hopper
description: Hopper window with a stone block in its filter slot, so only stone goes through

title: Morning mist
description: A birch forest at dawn, the far trees fading into a light mist

title: Butterflies and pollen
description: A plain at midday, full of flowers, with pollen drifting in the air and a butterfly among them

title: Biomes on the world map
description: World map with the pointer over an explored area and, holding Shift, the name of its biome

title: A refined interface
description: Crafting table with the reworked recipe book, drawn as a leather-bound book with cream pages and tabs

title: Sculk torch
description: A meadow at night seen with a sculk torch in hand, faint creeper faces lying on the grass where monsters can spawn, none around a torch

title: Woodcutter
description: The woodcutter's window, in wood tones like the stonecutter's, offering the pieces that one plank can be cut into

title: Advancements
description: Advancements screen with the Minecraft tab open, its advancements and the count made in each tab

title: Travel between waystones
description: A waystone's window: a box to name it, and the list of the others, tinted and with an icon for the Nether and the End

title: Food preview
description: Inventory with a food in hand, the drumsticks it would restore blinking in the hunger bar

title: Beehives through the spyglass
description: A beehive seen through the naturalist's spyglass, with its honey level and the number of bees inside

title: World loading screen
description: World loading screen: the explored map in sepia in a wooden frame, the chunks already loaded in full color around the player, a progress bar and a tip

title: World selection
description: World selection: the worlds on the left, the one selected on the right with a large icon, its game mode and difficulty, last session, time played and version

title: Info panels
description: Furnace with the tooltip of its “!” icon: cooking time, what the fuel will still cook and the experience held

title: Small tweaks
description: Redstone dust in hand, and the power of the wire looked at, from 0 to 15

title: Copper tweaks
description: Copper looked at with a honeycomb in hand, shown as waxed

title: Bookshelf tweaks
description: A chiseled bookshelf with the title and enchantment of the book in the slot looked at

title: Chest tweaks
description: A chest renamed with a name tag, its name shown when looked at

title: Armor stand tweaks
description: An armor stand with arms, wearing armor
